toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":80,"actionability":7,"reason":"The brief backs its claim with specific evidence (Pelion, handled by the same crew pool, stayed flat; the whole rise is in manual-encode bags; on the same days, Brackwater tags failed 1.6% vs 12.1% for Fennick), and that fits the timing of the tag-stock switch and the printer-jam spike; its steps are clear and can be reversed, though the 33-minute encode wait could still partly reflect handler behaviour."}

output.reason: The brief backs its claim with specific evidence (Pelion, handled by the same crew pool, stayed flat; the whole rise is in manual-encode bags; on the same days, Brackwater tags failed 1.6% vs 12.1% for Fennick), and that fits the timing of the tag-stock switch and the printer-jam spike; its steps are clear and can be reversed, though the 33-minute encode wait could still partly reflect handler behaviour.
